reference.title: Scenario 1 — Standard Multi - Column Table Reference

section.p: A section titled "Printer Configuration Parameters" contains a brief introductory sentence and a multi-column table of configuration settings. The heading contains the keyword "Parameters", and a lookup table dominates the body.

section.p: Result: The heading keyword "Parameters" combined with a multi-column lookup table triggers reference classification. Non-table prose before the table is wrapped in a <section> inside <refbody>. The multi-column HTML <table> maps to <simpletable>. Column header text maps to plain <stentry> elements.
